title: What the Giant Manta Ray means

is_this_you.pressure: When voices rise, you swing wide and keep moving. Nobody sees you leave the fight. You simply stop being in it.
is_this_you.love: You love at full wingspan, then hold still for the one person who gets to tend you.
is_this_you.cost: Everyone watches you skim the surface. Few ask what you went down for, and you rarely say.

opener.text: In Hawaiian the manta is hāhālua, and Roxanne Kapuaimohalaikalani Stewart of Kai Palaoa says the name can be read as "two breaths" [m10]. She places mantas in the second wā of the Kumulipo creation chant, among the deep divers who go where people cannot [m10]. You were born a Libra in a Dragon year. You take the second breath before you answer anyone, and you have always gone deeper than you show.

howto: Three parts, wide and slow. Start anywhere.

tabs.label: Two breaths
tabs.intro: Air that weighs, Earth that rules.

rows.text: Libra is cardinal Air, ruled by Venus, warm on first meeting and set on fairness [m1] [m2]. The Dragon is yang Earth, brave and persistent, at ease with risk [m3] [m4]. In you the scales ride on a very big body. You can weigh every side and still take up the whole sea.
A giant manta has to keep swimming so that water passes over its gills [m5]. You rest the same way. A slow glide calms you more than stopping does.
At a reef cleaning station it holds a near-stationary position for several minutes [m5]. That is the one stop you allow yourself. You choose the place with care and keep going back.

tabs.label: The deep
tabs.intro: People see the surface. What feeds you lives lower.

rows.text: A 2016 study of mantas off Ecuador estimated that most of their diet comes from the mesopelagic zone, roughly 200 to 1,000 meters down [m6]. A co-author put the split at about 73 percent deep food to 27 percent surface [m7]. You run on depth the same way, and surface watchers guess you wrong.

Its brain can weigh up to 200 grams, the largest of any fish [m5]. One small 2016 study suggested two captive mantas might recognize themselves in a mirror, and other researchers read the same behavior as ordinary social display [m8] [m9]. You care how you come across, and you are honest enough to doubt your own reflection.
Mediation and dive guiding both suit you. Each asks for a wide view and a calm way of moving people through deep water.

tabs.label: Who glides with you
tabs.intro: Three who share your current, and one who cuts across it.
tabs.love_lead: In love you court with the whole future. Then you need one fixed place where you can stop and be looked after. Three old Chinese pairings give you that place.

easy.why: The Red Panda (Libra, Rat year) completes your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey and shares your sign [m3] [m16].
The Raven (Aquarius, Monkey year) joins your trine through the Monkey, and Aquarius is Air like Libra [m3] [m1].
The Sunset Moth (Leo, Rooster year) is your secret friend, the Rooster being the Dragon's six-harmony partner, with Leo's Fire to warm your Air [m16].

hard.why: The one who cuts across you is the Duetting Frog (Libra, Dog year): your own sign on top, the Dragon and Dog clash underneath [m3] [m16].

story.text: Mandarin calls the manta 蝠鱝 (fúfèn), the bat ray [m13]. In Taiwan it is 鬼蝠魟 (guǐfúhóng), the ghost bat ray [m11]. Picture that wide shadow sliding under a fishing boat, and both names make sense. The ghost feeds on plankton and small prey, funnelled in by the fins on its head [m5].

closing: Keep your glide wide and slow. Nothing that moves that gently has to fight for its water.
